verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the schedule is out of date order (02 DEC, 13 JAN, 20 JAN, 16 DEC…), the legal line sits between two schedule rows, the WINTER PROGRAMME eyebrow has moved below the list, and the logo is shrunk and buried at the bottom. B keeps the original structure, but its left edges don't line up: the logo is at about x62, the eyebrow and headline at 51, the rows at 58 and the button at 46. The times and the image also end on different right edges, and the headline still wraps to an orphaned 'studios'.
